title: Blind Rage
description:
Blind Rage is the winning entry of the 2025 Game Jam held by Film Fund Luxembourg as part of the Immersive Pavilion. Not only did it win the contest, it won standing ovations during its presentation at the Neumünster Abbey in Luxembourg City. The game is the product of two days of work from Brevet de Technicien Supérieur Alumni and students in the Game Programming and Game Design, as well as Game Art and Game Design curricula.

You play as a blind schizophrenic who is tasked by eerie voices to commit burglaries and steal specific items. Of course, being blind makes this a daunting task. Mostly because, during your break-in, you didn't know the owner was home. Ah well, nothing you can do about now! Use noise to highlight your surroundings and find what you seek... or simply don't bump into the next best wall. But make too much noise and you will not only be chased but also caught. Luckily you can hide and avoid most of the trouble or it could be one of the shortest criminal careers ever!
description_short: The voices command you to commit a burglary! Unfortunately for them, you are blind and finding what they seek is a challenge! Chased after you try your best to not get caught and end up in the asylum.
